prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Account safety/persistence hints, path duration hints, personality headlines, and live generation countdown timers consistently improved performance.
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection improved performance, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Major redesigns, sub-flows, trait selectors, story copy, quality guidance, and estimated time headlines either hurt performance or showed no clear effect.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens yielded mixed results, winning in early rounds but hurting or showing no clear effect in later rounds.
Notifications and alerts, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy overhauls, and sign-in reordering after photo upload, while underestimating gains for hints, headlines, and countdown timers.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Pet Restoration Guarantee Hint on Sign In: Adds a reassurance hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in saves pet creation history and prevents account resets. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again; clear persistence messaging prevents confusion.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] Companion Photo Quality Guidance: Displays photo quality recommendations on the upload screen to ensure successful custom pet generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during adoption.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Control Overview Banner on Finish: Adds a concise hint on the final setup screen explaining how to access, control, or hide the desktop pet. (why: 3 support emails asked how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Background Safety Banner: Displays a persistence reassurance hint on the waiting screen explaining background rendering and auto-save. (why: Adoption to home transition loses users waiting over 200 seconds; clear status messaging prevents early drop-offs.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Quick Control Welcome Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding screen right before the intro screen explaining system tray pet controls. (why: Multiple users wrote to support asking how to show, hide, or control their pet after setup.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Validation Sub-Step Flow: Adds a photo validation sub-screen after upload to confirm photo quality before starting background generation. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation failures; validating inputs upfront prevents failed background generations.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Companion Performance Copy: Updates story intro body text to highlight smooth desktop performance and lightweight background operation. (why: Initial path choice step has long mean duration (514s); setting clear performance expectations upfront encourages progress.)

scores.note: Persistence hints on sign_in address 8 support emails and reliably boost conversion.
Quality guidance historically shows no clear effect despite support complaints.
Clear control hints on setup steps align with proven hint patterns.
Wait/persistence hints on home address high drop-off during background rendering.
Adding new screens at finish step historically yields 0% lift and requires release cost.
Sub-step flows hurt adoption conversion based on historical tests.
Copy updates on choose_path step consistently perform poorly (-3.2%).
